title: Pure Nimble
summary: Nimble is an explosive Level 2 WATER Fish and EARTH Beast Rank 2 Xyz and Link swarm engine centered around Nimble Angler and Nimble Beaver! When Nimble Angler is sent from your hand or Deck to the GY, Angler's mandatory trigger immediately Special Summons up to 2 Level 3 or lower 'Nimble' monsters directly from your Deck! Meanwhile, Normal Summoning Nimble Beaver Special Summons a 2nd Nimble from your Deck or GY for an instant 1-card Rank 2 Xyz (Gigantic Spright, Cat Shark, or Toadally Awesome)!

allow.Swap Frog: Level 2 WATER Aqua that discards 1 WATER monster (Nimble Angler!) to Special Summon itself, AND sends a Level 2 WATER monster (Nimble Angler #2!) from your Deck to the GY on Summon to summon 2 MORE Nimbles!
allow.Moray of Greed: Shuffles 2 WATER Nimble monsters from your hand into the Deck to draw 3 cards.
allow.Surface: Revives Level 2 WATER Beast/Fish Nimble Beaver, Nimble Angler, or Swap Frog from your GY.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Nimble Angler directly from your Deck to the GY—immediately Special Summoning 2 Nimble Beaver from your Deck with zero Normal Summon used!
allow.Spright Sprind: Link-2 monster that sends any Level 2 monster (Nimble Angler!) directly from your Deck to the GY on Link Summon—triggering Angler to summon 2 more Nimbles from the Deck!
allow.Gigantic Spright: Rank 2 Xyz that detaches 1 material to Special Summon Nimble Beaver or Swap Frog directly from your Deck.
allow.Cat Shark: Rank 2 WATER Beast Xyz that detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to double the original ATK of Gigantic Spright (to 6400 ATK!).
allow.Toadally Awesome: Rank 2 WATER Aqua Xyz made with two Swap Frogs for omni-negation.
allow.Marincess Coral Anemone: Link-2 WATER monster that revives Nimble Beaver, Nimble Angler, or Swap Frog from your GY.

main: Core 1-card starter (Level 2 WATER Beast): when Normal Summoned, Special Summons 1 Level 3 or lower 'Nimble' monster from your Deck or GY—immediately assembling Rank 2 Gigantic Spright or Link-2 Spright Sprind!
Core swarm engine (Level 2 WATER Fish): if this card is sent from your hand OR Deck to the GY, Special Summons up to 2 Level 3 or lower 'Nimble' monsters directly from your Deck!
Level 2 WATER Fish: when destroyed by battle, sends Nimble Angler from your Deck to the GY (triggering Angler to summon 2 Nimbles!), then Special Summons 1 Nimble Sunfish from your Deck!
Level 2 WATER Fish: when sent from the field to the GY by a card effect, Special Summons any number of 'Nimble Manta' from your Deck.
Iconic Level 2 EARTH Beast: when destroyed by battle, gains 1000 LP and Special Summons up to 2 'Nimble Momonga' from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

Core enabler: discards Nimble Angler from your hand to Special Summon itself, then sends Nimble Angler #2 from your Deck to the GY on Summon—putting 5 Level 2 monsters on the board before you even Normal Summon!
Special Summons Level 2 WATER Beast Nimble Beaver or Swap Frog from your GY in Defense Position.
Returns extra Nimble Angler, Manta, or Sunfish from your hand to the Deck to draw 3 fresh cards.
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Nimble Angler from your Deck to the GY to immediately Special Summon 2 Nimble Beaver from your Deck.
extra: Link-2 monster: sends Level 2 Nimble Angler directly from your Deck to the GY on Link Summon—triggering Angler to Special Summon 2 more Nimbles from your Deck!
Rank 2 Xyz: gains double original ATK when made with a Link-2, and detaches 1 material to summon Swap Frog or Nimble Beaver from your Deck!
Rank 2 WATER Beast Xyz: cannot be destroyed by battle while it has a WATER material, and detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to double Gigantic Spright's ATK to 6400!
Rank 2 WATER Aqua Xyz made with two Swap Frogs for omni-negation and recursion.
Link-2 WATER monster that revives Nimble Beaver or Swap Frog from your GY.
Link-2: Quick Effect Link Summons during opponent's Main Phase and gives the summoned monster effect-destruction immunity.
Link-2: banishes a card on the field/GY on summon and banishes 2 face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.
Link-3: discards 1 card on summon to shuffle any card on the field into the Deck, and draws cards if co-linked.
